selection_rule: For anatomical positions 01..10 in ascending order, enumerate subjects with all six expected files and official checksum entries; rank by SHA256(seed|position|subject); select the first two SHA256-verified candidates whose subject has not already been selected. Only an objective missing, unreadable, decoded-corrupt, or checksum-failing source permits replacement.

exclusions_and_replacements.details: The 500 and 1000 ppi plain files decode as the expected fingerprint, but the 2000 ppi plain file decodes as horizontal scan-line noise over a large black field. The file matches the distributed checksum, so the corruption is present in the local official source payload.
